# RAIM SMILE — reusable partner packages

Named partner activation requires a signed pilot charter, capacity, legal/privacy, current-operator disclosure and measurable distribution. The canonical tier/funding matrix is `RAIM_SMILE_PARTNER_PROGRAM_MATRIX.md`.

## 1. Common product formula

```text
Partner privilege
= clinic-funded SmileCare 12 gift within a capped quota
+ one-window non-clinical Dental Concierge
+ partner-specific Premium and family rules
```

For the baseline pilot allocation, the partner does **not** pay for SmileCare 12 memberships. The clinic treats the gift as a bounded acquisition investment. The partner contributes recurring access to the eligible audience, eligibility confirmation, approved communications and pilot feedback.

No package is issued automatically to the full audience. Every activation requires opt-in, eligibility, clinical qualification, available quota and capacity.

## 2. SmileCare 12 boundary

The current clinic-confirmed product is publicly named **RAIM SMILE · SmileCare 12**. Its current benefits and prices remain governed by the product standard and price catalog. Expanded Essential, Perio, Kids & Teens and Family Account remain separately gated.

For every SmileCare-related package:

- a licensed operator assigns any clinical plan;
- the partner never receives diagnosis, imaging, treatment plan or clinical tier;
- each person keeps an individual benefit balance;
- benefits are not transferred between relatives;
- treatment and imaging outside the current binding are paid separately;
- the package is not insurance and does not promise a treatment result;
- current operator, exclusions and expiry are disclosed before activation.

## 3. Default Premium tier matrix

| Partner tier | Clinic-funded gift | Family terms | Coordination |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Premium Individual** | one SmileCare 12 for the primary holder | spouse and children may join under current approved add-on prices | personal coordinator for the holder |
| **Private / Infinite** | primary holder plus one selected dependent, within the signed quota | remaining family members join under approved add-on terms | household scheduling and one family contact |
| **Top Tier / World Elite** | primary holder, one additional adult and up to two children, within the family allocation | further participants join under approved add-on terms | extended family coordination and priority organisational windows |

This is the default negotiation structure, not a claim about any named bank. Exact tier names, free allocation, age limits, substitutions and total capacity are set in the signed pilot charter.

## 4. Private Banking / Premium Card

**Working name:** `RAIM SMILE Private Dental Privilege`

Core:

- clinic-funded SmileCare 12 gift within a capped activation quota;
- Premium Individual / Private / Top Tier differentiation;
- multilingual Dental Concierge;
- family scheduling under the selected tier;
- future phone-key access after its security/privacy release gates;
- access to Second Opinion after that product becomes active;
- partner-specific source and eligibility route.

Partner value: a tangible premium-card benefit that saves the client from searching for a dentist and coordinating providers alone.

The bank is not invoiced for the baseline SmileCare 12 gift allocation. Any paid extension, additional family inventory, Coordination Fee or special service line must be separately signed; it is not implied by the public page.

RAIM SMILE asks for: privileges catalogue/app placement, concierge/front-line script, recurring member communications, verified eligibility and a pilot owner.

## 5. Employer / International Company / Executive Program

**Working name:** `RAIM SMILE Executive & Employee Dental Privilege`

Core:

- clinic-funded Individual quota for selected executives/key employees;
- Private or Top Tier family allocation for higher employee grades;
- multilingual coordination for foreign specialists;
- family scheduling;
- optional Second Opinion after activation;
- educational sessions for employees.

Partner value: a concrete health-and-wellbeing benefit for hard-to-replace employees without access to their medical information.

RAIM SMILE asks for: opt-in employee communication, eligibility confirmation, HR/benefits owner and defined cohort. Government or public-sector cohorts follow the same privacy and anti-favouritism controls and require an authorised institutional agreement.

## 6. Residential / Developer / Property Manager

**Working name:** `RAIM SMILE Resident & Family Privilege`

Core:

- clinic-funded activation quota for eligible residents;
- tiered family allocation linked to the property/community privilege level;
- family booking windows when capacity permits;
- parent education and dental-trauma organisational guide;
- one-window coordinator;
- periodic resident communication.

Partner value: an ongoing resident benefit rather than a one-time flyer.

RAIM SMILE asks for: access to occupied communities through resident app/chat/email/lobby/screens/events, eligibility confirmation and recurring distribution.

## 7. Premium Fitness / Club

**Working name:** `RAIM SMILE Club Dental Privilege`

Core:

- clinic-funded SmileCare 12 Individual quota;
- selected dependent/family upgrades for higher club tiers;
- Dental Concierge;
- clinician-led sports-dentistry, mouthguard and trauma education;
- family booking support;
- co-branded wellness content/events.

Partner value: a relevant health benefit and useful programming, not a generic discount.

RAIM SMILE asks for: club app/email/front-desk placement, event access, eligibility and source attribution. Medical care is never promised on club premises.

## 8. Business Club / Chamber / Executive Community

**Working name:** `RAIM SMILE Executive Member Privilege`

Core:

- clinic-funded Individual or Private allocation;
- Dental Concierge;
- compact scheduled route for time-sensitive executives;
- Second Opinion after activation;
- expert sessions;
- family add-ons under approved terms.

Partner value: a member benefit and practical executive-health content.

RAIM SMILE asks for: opt-in newsletter/app communication, event access, a pilot owner and introductions only to members who chose to engage.

## 9. International School / Family Community

**Working name:** `RAIM SMILE International Family Support`

Core:

- multilingual coordinator for eligible parents;
- clinic-funded child/family quota only after clinical, capacity, consent and fiscal rules are approved;
- family scheduling;
- preventive education;
- dental-trauma organisational guide;
- parent-facing communications.

Partner value: useful support for local and international families.

The school does not market medical services directly to children and does not bypass parental consent. It receives no medical information.

## 10. Hotel / Concierge / Expat Service

**Working name:** `RAIM SMILE Guest Dental Concierge`

Core:

- multilingual non-clinical coordination;
- appointment and logistics support;
- one-window handoff to the disclosed operator;
- alternative operator arrangement when the primary clinic lacks capacity or a required specialist;
- Second Opinion for non-urgent complex cases after activation.

SmileCare 12 is offered only to eligible residents or longer-term members under a separate quota; it is not emergency cover for every hotel guest.

Partner value: a reliable organisational response when a guest asks where to seek dental help.

## 11. One-window operator rule

The current primary medical operator in Bishkek is **Expert Dental Studio**.

If it cannot accept the case within the agreed capacity or lacks the required specialist, the coordinator arranges a handoff to a prequalified alternative clinic and remains responsible for organisational follow-up until the appointment is confirmed.

Unless a signed charter explicitly states otherwise:

- SmileCare 12 included benefits do not automatically transfer to another clinic;
- that clinic uses its own medical agreement and price list;
- treatment there may require separate payment;
- the participant is told who will provide medical care before the visit;
- the partner does not select providers based on commercial payment ahead of quality and eligibility.

## 12. Concierge, languages and response target

First named coordinator: **Гульбара**. Languages: Russian, Kyrgyz, English and French.

The target for a covered pilot shift is a first human organisational response within **10 minutes**. This is not a clinical consultation or promise that a case will be solved within 10 minutes.

`24/7 non-clinical Dental Concierge` may be used publicly only after the covered-hours schedule, backup, escalation, measured SLA and clinical fallback are operational. It never means 24/7 medical care or round-the-clock doctor availability.

## 13. Funding and CAESTHETIC boundary

For a paid approved partner/VIP membership, the owner-approved 30% fee applies only to actually collected and retained SmileCare 12 membership revenue after legal/fiscal, signed schedule and max-use approval.

For a clinic-funded gift:

- partner membership price is zero;
- if no internal membership settlement occurs, the 30% revenue basis is zero;
- CAESTHETIC may be paid only through a separately signed fixed pilot/activation management fee and/or Coordination Fee;
- 100% of a separate Coordination Fee belongs to CAESTHETIC;
- treatment revenue share for CAESTHETIC and the coordinator is 0%.

Full accounting rules: `RAIM_SMILE_PARTNERSHIP_ECONOMICS_CONTRACT.md`.

## 14. Reporting before dashboard

A live partner dashboard is deferred. The first pilot uses a short aggregate report covering activation, coordinator contacts, appointments, attendance, measured response time, complaints/opt-outs, capacity and remaining gift quota.

No report contains names, diagnosis, images, treatment plan or individual treatment revenue.

## 15. Common package contract

Every package must define:

1. eligible audience and tier mapping;
2. eligibility proof and opt-in;
3. clinic-funded quota and family allocation;
4. current included benefit and exclusions;
5. partner distribution surfaces and frequency;
6. source attribution;
7. service owner and backup;
8. primary and alternative operator rules;
9. duration and review date;
10. commercial consideration, if any;
11. capacity cap;
12. SLA wording and covered hours;
13. stop/termination/privacy terms;
14. aggregate reporting owner;
15. rollback for participant communication.

The partner does not transfer a client list. A one-time flyer without recurring access and an accountable pilot owner does not qualify as a full partnership.
